description: A Java class representing a response DTO for an order item, including properties for ID, product ID, quantity, and unit amount, with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: OrderItemResponse
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) for order item responses, encapsulating order item details.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the order item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the UUID of the order item.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the associated product.

methods.name: setProductId
methods.description: Sets the UUID of the associated product.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the order item.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the order item.

methods.name: getUnitAmount
methods.description: Returns the unit amount in minor currency units.

methods.name: setUnitAmount
methods.description: Sets the unit amount in minor currency units.
